title: Oz campervans
titleCn: Oz campervans 房车租赁咨询

paragraphs.text: Section one.
You will hear a telephone conversation between a sales representative and a customer about hiring a camper van. First, you have some time to look at questions one to five on page two.
You will see that there is an example that has been done for you. On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.
Hello. Oz Camper Vans. Barry here.

Oh, hello. Uh, we're planning a trip to Tasmania this summer. And rather than stay in hotels or motels, we thought it would be nice to have our own van that we could sleep in. So I need to hire a camper van.
Okay. Well, if you tell me what your needs are, I can prepare a quote for you.
Okay, great.
Now, I'll need some contact details. Your name is?
Caroline Smith.
The customer's name is Caroline Smith, so Smith has been written in the space.
Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time.
Listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Hello. Oz Camper Vans. Barry here.

Oh, hello. Uh, we're planning a trip to Tasmania this summer. And rather than stay in hotels or motels, we thought it would be nice to have our own van that we could sleep in. So I need to hire a camper van.
Okay. Well, if you tell me what your needs are, I can prepare a quote for you.
Okay, great.
Now, I'll need some contact details. Your name is?
Caroline Smith.
Thank you. And what's your address?
14 Gray Street, Forest Hill.
Oh, I know it. And if I can just get a contact telephone number.
I'll give you my mobile number. It's 0419657156.
And do you have an email address?
Yeah, it's caroline at easymail dot com.
Great. We can email a copy of the quote to you.
Actually, I'd prefer to get it in the post because my computer's playing up at the moment.
Got it. Okay, then, Caroline. What kind of camper van are you interested in?
Well, I don't know very much about them.
Okay. Can you tell me how many people there are in your group?
Well, there's my husband, our daughter, and me, of course. That's all.
Well, we have a model called the Explorer, which would suit you.
I'll choose that one then.
Now, it's really for two people, but we can supply you with an additional bed. The roof pops up, and it fits in there.
Yes. We'll be needing one of those then.
Okay. I'll put that down on the quote as well.
How much is that one, by the way? I've budgeted for 50 dollars a day.
Well, the daily rate on that one is only 39 dollars, so you'll save 11 dollars a day.
I see. Well, that's not too bad. Does that price include petrol too?
No, but it does include blankets, pillows, and sheets, as well as all the things you need in the kitchen.
Oh, good.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten on page two.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
We do offer some additional optional extras. Would you like to hear about them?
Sure, since we're saving a bit of money.
Well, for a small additional fee, we can provide a heater, a TV, a microwave, or a coffee maker.
We'll definitely need a heater.
Yes. It can get pretty cold in Tasmania.
I know. I want to get away from it all, so no TV. But a microwave would be useful.
Anything else?
None of us drink coffee, so I think that's all.
Now, you said that you were going to Tasmania.
That's right. We want to fly to Hobart from Brisbane, pick up the van, and then drive from there to Huonville.
Right. Now, we have two branches in Hobart. Do you want to pick up your van from the city center branch or get it from the one at the airport when you land?
Oh, the airport one. We don't want to have to go into the city center. We want to start traveling immediately.
Okay, I'll put that down. Now, how long do you need the van for?
About two weeks. Is that okay?
Yep, that should be fine.
Oh, good. Well, thanks very much for all your help.
No problem. Oh, can I just run through a few more details with you? It's just related to our insurance.
Oh, yeah. Sure.
Now, are you and your husband both planning on driving the van?
Uh, yes. Yes, we are. Is that a problem?
No, it's no problem. I just need the age of the youngest driver. That's an insurance requirement.
My daughter's 19, and she's keen to drive.
Oh, well, unfortunately, she won't be able to drive the van, as you need to be at least 25 years of age.
Oh, I see. Well, put my age down then. I'm 49.
Sure. Just one more question. It's another insurance requirement. Do you and your husband both have Australian driver's licenses? It costs a little extra if you have an overseas one.
Well, my husband is originally from America, but yes, we've both got our licenses here in Australia.
Great. Well, that's all I need from you. So I'll get that quote out to you in the post.
That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
